_comment: Hand-maintained, not generated. Read by configs/scripts/context-policy.py (install.sh section 8d, `status`, `--check`). Every value is a DEFAULT Clade owns only while ~/.claude/settings.json still holds exactly what Clade wrote (recorded in ~/.claude/.clade-context-state.json): a value the user sets, or a key the user deletes, is theirs from then on and is never rewritten or re-added. Change a value only with a new measurement in the same commit. While present, the key outranks a window Anthropic sets server-side (the clientdata tier) and the experiment tier on 2.1.283 and on 2.1.288+ alike, so context-policy.py retracts its value and writes none while Claude Code's global config caches a clientdata window (autoCompactWindowsCache, or rowan_thicket in the client-data cache). That is best-effort: the cache names are undocumented, read from the 2.1.283 binary, and the experiment tier is not detected, so re-verify on each Claude Code upgrade (TODO.md, 2026-11-05 context policy follow-ups).

measurement.source: context-window research run on aries, 2026-11-05 (sweet_sim.py, quota_weight.py); the cited .out files are research outputs, not part of this repository
measurement.population: 30 days to 2026-11-05, aries, both profiles: 224 main + 5,891 subagent threads, 82.0B tokens / $32.2K at list price; replay with behaviour held fixed
measurement.trigger: compaction fires at W - min(maxOut, 20000) - 13000 = 317,000 for W = 350,000 (default today: 967,000); formula read in the 2.1.283 and 2.1.318 binaries
measurement.cost: 350K saves $3,734 (11.6%) with 1,371 compactions (main 241 in 85 of 224 sessions, subagents 1,130 in 934 of 5,891 agents); 300K saves $3,885 (12.1%) with 2,416; 400K saves $3,304 (10.3%) with 827 (sweet_sim.out:23-25, :34-35)
measurement.robustness: 350K is maximin and min-regret across 5 simulation variants: saves at least $2,732 in every variant, max regret $545; 300K saves at least $2,062, regret $670 (sweet_sim.out:155)
measurement.quota: fitted Max-5h weight of a cache read r ~= 0.028x uncached input (95% CI 0.022-0.036 with write/output weights at list, 0.015-0.050 all free); at r = 0.028 main-thread quota saved is 37.4% at 300K and 33.1% at 400K; 350K was not simulated under quota weighting (UNVERIFIED)
measurement.subagents: on 2.1.283 subagents inherit the main window, so one value serves both; at r = 0.028 a 200K window costs subagents +16.9% quota, which is why the value never goes below 300K while they share it
measurement.confidence: cost MEDIUM-HIGH, quota MEDIUM, quality LOW-MEDIUM: 'no performance loss' is not shown; the opt-in trial in TODO.md (2026-11-05 context policy follow-ups) exists to test it

codex.decision: no change: gpt-6-astra already compacts at 244,800 (90% of its 272,000 window)
codex.reason: no per-model scoping: model_context_window would also clamp gpt-6.1-sol at 500K and every subagent; config.toml is user-scoped (configs/codex-migration.json)

kimi.decision: deferred: Kimi idle since 2026-10-17; k3 compacts at 891,290 (0.85 x 1,048,576)
kimi.manual_option: [models."kimi-code/k3".overrides] max_input_size = 350000 compacts k3 at 297,500 and survives a model refresh; it also applies to k3 subagents, which were not simulated. Never use the global compaction_trigger_ratio or reserved_context_size: they hit every model, and the ratio's floor of 0.5 cannot reach 350K
